Container.Name: stockportfolio
Container.Overview: Portfolio management with market data, valuation, charts and tolerance-band rebalancing in your browser. Quotes, asset types and price history come from a separate StockInfo API. Trade plans are simulations; no orders are placed.[br][br]Portfolio data and settings are stored only in the browser, not on Unraid. No appdata volume is needed. Export backups under Settings - Backup; server backups do not include browser data. Keep the web address and host port stable when updating.[br][br]Set STOCKINFO_API_URL to an address reachable from your browser. StockInfo must allow the web app origin through CORS. HTTPS pages require an HTTPS API.[br][br]The container serves the web app on port 8080 without root privileges. Older images used port 80: update existing port mappings when upgrading.
Container.Requires: A StockInfo API reachable from the browser.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app. The container listens on 8080. Keep the host address and port stable to retain the browser storage origin.

Config.Name: StockInfo API
Config.Description: URL of your StockInfo API, reachable from the browser (for example https://stockinfo.example.com). Required; no built-in public API. Restart the container after changing it.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for container logs, for example Europe/Vienna. The web interface follows the browser timezone.
